blocks.en: The fitting of ships refers to both the process of selecting which modules, rigs, ammunition, drones, etc. should be used with it for it to be able to do what the player wants it to, and to the act of then actually assembling a ship hull and placing the above-mentioned items in it so that the ship becomes ready to be undocked and used.
blocks.zh: 舰船装配既指挑选舰船要用的装备、改装件、弹药、无人机等，让它能完成玩家想做的事；也指实际组装船体，并把上述物品装上去，让舰船可以离站使用。

blocks.en: There are no strict rules that you must follow when fitting a ship; these guidelines are designed to help you until you know when you can ignore them. Ship fitting is a wide-ranging topic, and players may wish to come back to both the foundational principles as well as more detailed considerations as they gain familiarity with it. Good sources of more advanced information on ship fitting that go beyond the scope of a general article on it are also third-party sites that host information pages dedicated to specific areas of gameplay.
blocks.zh: 装配舰船时并没有必须遵守的硬性规定；这些准则是为了在你还不知道什么时候可以无视它们之前提供帮助。舰船装配是个涉及面很广的话题，随着越来越熟悉，玩家可能会想回头重温基础原则和更细致的考量。还有一些第三方网站专门针对特定玩法提供信息页面，是获取超出一般性文章范围的高级装配知识的好来源。

blocks.en: Assembling a fit
blocks.zh: 组装配置

blocks.en: Here are some tips for buying and assembling your fit:
blocks.zh: 以下是购买和组装配置的一些建议：

en: Use the ship simulator: From the fitting window of any ship in EVE (even ones you don't own) you can start simulating a fit, and see how the ship's stats change with different modules. You can then conveniently buy the whole fit from the market.
zh: 使用舰船模拟器：在 EVE 中任何舰船（即使是你没有的舰船）的装配窗口中，都可以开始模拟一套配置，查看换不同装备时舰船属性的变化。之后还可以很方便地从市场一键购买整套配置。

en: Consider buying at trade hubs; they are more likely to have all the parts you need.
zh: 考虑在贸易中心购买；那里更可能备齐你需要的所有部件。

blocks.en: Fitting skills
blocks.zh: 装配技能

blocks.en: Main article: Fitting skills
blocks.zh: 主条目：装配技能

blocks.en: Fitting skills reduce the CPU or powergrid requirements of modules or just give you more raw CPU or powergrid to play with. Having decent fitting skills is very useful. Very good fitting skills really help you to fit T2 modules and weapons, which demand more CPU and powergrid than their T1 equivalents, and to fit T2 ships, which often have tight powergrid and CPU. Levels in these skills are often required to fit useful modules, too.
blocks.zh: 装配技能可以降低装备对 CPU 或能量栅格的需求，或者直接给你更多的 CPU 和能量栅格。拥有不错的装配技能非常有用。很好的装配技能能大大帮助你装上 T2 装备和武器（它们比对应的 T1 版本需要更多 CPU 和能量栅格），以及装配往往能量栅格和 CPU 都很紧张的 T2 舰船。很多实用装备也要求这些技能达到一定等级才能装配。

blocks.en: (Note that Hull Upgrades doesn't make basic fitting easier, even though it has 'Upgrades' in its name. It gives a pilot 5% more armor per level, and Hull Upgrades at Lvl 5 is required to fit a Tech 2 armor tank.)
blocks.zh: （注意，船体加固理论（Hull Upgrades）虽然名字里有“加固 / 升级”，但并不会让基础装配变得更容易。它每级给飞行员增加 5% 装甲，而装配 T2 装甲坦克需要船体加固理论 5 级。）

blocks.en: Tip: The benefits of CPU Management and Power Grid Management apply to the whole ship. Skill point for skill point, they provide significantly more fitting benefit than the module-specific skills. You can't go wrong training these two skills to level V as soon as is practical.
blocks.zh: 提示：CPU管理学和能量栅格管理学的加成作用于整艘舰船。同样的技能点投入，它们带来的装配收益远高于针对特定装备的技能。条件允许时尽早把这两个技能练到 V 级，绝对不会错。

blocks.en: General theory
blocks.zh: 基本理论

blocks.en: Fit for a purpose
blocks.zh: 按用途装配

blocks.en: Generally, the more tasks you want a fit to do, the worse it performs at each particular task. Some ships have very specific uses: a Venture mining frigate is not very helpful in either PvE or PvP combat.
blocks.zh: 一般来说，你希望一套配置承担的任务越多，它在每项具体任务上的表现就越差。有些舰船的用途非常专一：冲锋者级采矿护卫舰在 PvE 和 PvP 战斗中都帮不上什么忙。

blocks.en: But even a combat ship will almost certainly need different fits for PvE and PvP, because, for example, in PvP, you usually receive a lot more damage in a much more limited time than in PvE, and enemy players, unlike NPCs, need to be prevented from warping away. Even within PvP, the same ship can have one fit for close-range brawling in a small gang and a completely different fit for fighting at longer ranges in a large fleet.
blocks.zh: 但即使是战斗舰船，几乎也肯定需要为 PvE 和 PvP 准备不同的配置。比如，在 PvP 中，你通常会在比 PvE 短得多的时间内承受多得多的伤害；而且与 NPC 不同，敌方玩家需要被阻止跃迁逃跑。即使同样是 PvP，同一艘船也可以有一套用于小队近距离近战的配置，以及一套完全不同的、用于大舰队远距离作战的配置。

blocks.en: Of course, there are dangers in over-specialization too, especially when you're not working with other players. If you're going to exploit a low-class wormhole while solo you want your ship to deal and tank damage, launch probes, and maybe cloak so that you can hide if you see a gang of enemies on your directional scanner. Strategic Cruisers and, to some extent, Tactical Destroyers are specifically designed to be flexible multitask ships.
blocks.zh: 当然，过度专精也有风险，尤其是在你没有和其他玩家一起行动的时候。如果你要单人开发低等级虫洞，就会希望舰船既能输出又能抗伤害，能发射探针，也许还能隐形，这样当你在定向扫描上看到一伙敌人时可以躲起来。战略巡洋舰以及在一定程度上的战术驱逐舰，就是专门设计成灵活多用途的舰船。

blocks.en: Some useful aspects of a fit's design to consider in thinking about its purpose are:
blocks.zh: 思考一套配置的用途时，以下几个方面值得考虑：

en: Engagement Range: if it is a combat fit, at what range do you want the fit to fight?
Brawling (<15km)
Kiting (15–30km, that is, within warp disruption range, which will vary depending on the hull and the presence or absence of bursts affecting this)
Skirmishing (30–100km)
Sniping (100km+)
Role: what will your fit do on the battlefield?
Primary damage dealer ("DD")
Tackler
Scout
Logistics
Electronic warfare
Screen (holding hostile tackle or DD ships away from the core of a friendly gang)
Tank: how will your fit avoid or counter incoming damage?
Buffer armor tank
Active armor tank
Buffer shield tank
Passive shield tank
Active shield tank
Speed tank
Range tank (there are very few situations where you want no tank!)

Will the damage type be predictable? For instance, PvP against Amarr laser ships and PvE combat in missions, Incursions, and combat sites can involve highly predictable damage types which can be accounted for in advance.
Environment: where will your fit operate?
High security space: collateral damage will be risky
Low security space: gate and station guns are a risk for any aggressor
Null security space: bubbles might be used, as might bombs; accessible stations/structures might be rare
ESS grids: only some hull sizes can enter, microwarpdrives and micro jump drives won't function, and warping will be impossible
Wormhole space/Pochven: intel will be more limited; basic probing capabilities might come in handy
Abyssal Deadspace: only some hull sizes can enter; damage types will be unpredictable; environmental conditions will affect the ship
Cost: can you fly this ship over and over again?
Ships are ammo. Every ship you undock will be lost at some point.
Everyone loses ships regularly.
Can you refit the ship to be more affordable, making the sting of losing one better?
Can you do a cheap implant to prevent having to fit an expensive compact module?
Note: the fitting cost in the bottom right of the fitting window is (incorrectly but purposefully) set up to show the cost of individual modules but does show an accurate total cost at the top.
zh: 交战距离：如果是战斗配置，你希望它在什么距离作战？
近战（<15km）
风筝（15–30km，即在跃迁扰断范围之内，具体取决于船体以及是否有影响该范围的指挥脉冲）
狙击（100km+）
定位：你的配置在战场上要做什么？
主力输出（“DD”）
拦截
侦察
后勤
电子战
掩护（把敌方的拦截舰或输出舰挡在己方小队核心之外）
坦克：你的配置如何规避或抵消受到的伤害？
缓冲装甲坦克
主动装甲坦克
缓冲护盾坦克
被动护盾坦克
主动护盾坦克
速度坦克
距离坦克（需要完全不带坦克的情况极少！）
伤害类型是否可以预测？比如，PvP 中对抗艾玛激光舰船，以及任务、入侵和战斗站点中的 PvE 战斗，伤害类型往往高度可预测，可以提前做好针对。
环境：你的配置将在哪里活动？
高安：误伤风险大
低安：星门和空间站的炮台对任何主动攻击者都是威胁
00 区：可能会遇到扰断泡和炸弹；可停靠的空间站 / 建筑可能很少
ESS 网格：只有部分体型的船体能进入，微型跃迁推进器和微型跳跃引擎无法使用，也无法跃迁
虫洞空间 / 波赫文：情报更有限；基础的探针扫描能力可能会派上用场
深渊：只有部分体型的船体能进入；伤害类型无法预测；环境条件会影响舰船
成本：你能一次又一次地开这艘船吗？
舰船就是弹药。你开出去的每一艘船迟早都会丢。
每个人都会经常丢船。
能不能把舰船改装得更实惠一些，让丢船时不那么心疼？
能不能用一个便宜的植入体，来避免装昂贵的紧凑型装备？
注意：装配窗口右下角的装配费用（虽然不准确但有意为之）设置为显示单个装备的价格，不过顶部显示的总价是准确的。

blocks.en: For all kinds of fit, for all kinds of purposes, ask yourself what level of risk will you expose this fit to? A fit used for highly predictable PvE combat or for mining in relatively secure space can be more expensive than one used for one-way filament PvP trips to hostile nullsec space--though even in the safest kinds of environment you must never fly what you can't afford to lose.
blocks.zh: 无论是哪种配置、用于什么目的，都要问问自己：这套配置要面对多大的风险？用于高度可预测的 PvE 战斗，或者在相对安全的空间采矿的配置，可以比用于纤维单程前往敌对 00 区 PvP 的配置更贵一些——不过即使在最安全的环境中，也绝不要开你丢不起的船。

blocks.en: Consider a ship's bonuses
blocks.zh: 考虑舰船的加成

blocks.en: Every ship comes with per-level bonuses, which often point toward the uses that the ship was designed for.
blocks.zh: 每艘舰船都有按技能等级提供的加成，这些加成通常指明了舰船的设计用途。

blocks.en: The Caldari Blackbird, for example, gets a 15% bonus to ECM Target Jammer strength and a 12.5% bonus to ECM Target Jammer optimal range and falloff for each level its pilot has in the Caldari Cruiser skill. These bonuses suggest that it's best fitted as an electronic warfare platform that fights well at long range.
blocks.zh: 比如加达里的黑鸟级，飞行员的加达里巡洋舰操作技能每升一级，ECM 目标干扰器强度提高 15%，ECM 目标干扰器最佳射程和失准范围提高 12.5%。这些加成表明它最适合装配成擅长远距离作战的电子战平台。

blocks.en: Sometimes it's okay not to take advantage of a ship's bonuses: although the Brutix is bonused to give a more efficient active armor tank, it is frequently seen with a buffer tank, and quite often a shield tank at that. This is because the ship has the ability to supply a huge amount of DPS with its six damage bonused blasters and a shield tank leaves the lowslots free for damage upgrades to squeeze out even more damage.
blocks.zh: 有时候不利用舰船的加成也没问题：布鲁提克斯级虽然有让主动装甲坦克更高效的加成，但经常能看到它用缓冲坦克，而且往往还是护盾坦克。这是因为这艘船凭借六门有伤害加成的爆能枪能打出极高的 DPS，而护盾坦克能把低槽空出来装伤害强化装备，榨出更多伤害。

blocks.en: Don't mix tanks
blocks.zh: 不要混合坦克

blocks.en: If you're going to tank, either shield tank or armor tank. Don't both shield and armor tank in the same fit.
blocks.zh: 如果要做坦克，要么护盾坦克，要么装甲坦克。不要在同一套配置里同时做护盾坦克和装甲坦克。

blocks.en: Most of the time, a tank takes up a substantial proportion of your powergrid, your CPU, and either your midslots (for a shield tank) or your lowslots (armor tank). If you fit a shield tank, you can put useful things (damage modules, speed and agility modules, etc.) in your lowslots; if you armor tank, you can put useful things (tackling modules, electronic warfare modules, propulsion modules, etc.) in your midslots. Utilizing both types of tank at once leaves you with little space for other useful modules.
blocks.zh: 大多数情况下，坦克会占用相当大一部分能量栅格和 CPU，以及中槽（护盾坦克）或低槽（装甲坦克）。如果你做护盾坦克，就可以在低槽装有用的东西（伤害装备、速度和灵活度装备等）；如果做装甲坦克，就可以在中槽装有用的东西（拦截装备、电子战装备、推进装备等）。同时使用两种坦克，就几乎没有空间装其它有用的装备了。

blocks.en: Furthermore, fitting Shield Extenders and Shield Rigs increases Signature Radius, and fitting Armor Plates and Armor Rigs reduces your speed, both of which will cause you to get hit more and harder, thus burning through your hitpoints faster.
blocks.zh: 此外，装配护盾扩展装置和护盾改装件会增大信号半径，装配装甲附甲板和装甲改装件会降低速度，这两者都会让你更容易被打中、被打得更狠，从而更快耗尽血量。

blocks.en: This rule also applies to mixing buffer tank with active tank: these modules both require heavy powergrid and CPU, both consume the same limited set of slots, and both fitting theories satisfy different—usually mutually exclusive—goals and conditions.
blocks.zh: 这条规则同样适用于混合缓冲坦克和主动坦克：这两类装备都很吃能量栅格和 CPU，都占用同样有限的槽位，而且两种装配思路满足的是不同的、通常互相排斥的目标和条件。

blocks.en: The above two options are not the only ones, but the vast majority of widely used fits use either a shield or armor tank. Double-tanked ships are usually only used as bait, or with a small subset of hulls for 1v1 fights (most prominently the Breacher). Hull-tanking is a strategy that is sometimes fielded to great effect in solo and small-gang PvP.
blocks.zh: 以上两种并不是仅有的选择，但绝大多数广泛使用的配置都采用护盾坦克或装甲坦克。双坦克的舰船通常只用作诱饵，或者用于少数几种船体的 1v1 对战（最典型的是分裂者级）。结构坦克是一种在单人和小队 PvP 中有时能发挥奇效的策略。

blocks.en: Don't mix guns
blocks.zh: 不要混用武器

blocks.en: If you have a rack of exactly identical guns on your ship, they will all have precisely the same optimal and falloff ranges and exactly the same tracking. This means you only have to worry about getting your ship to one ideal range and keeping the enemy's angular velocity below one value.
blocks.zh: 如果你的舰船装了一排完全相同的炮，它们的最佳射程、失准范围和跟踪速度都完全一样。这意味着你只需要考虑把舰船保持在一个理想距离，并把敌人的角速度控制在一个数值以下。

blocks.en: Furthermore, you can group identical weapons so that they can all be activated or reloaded or unloaded at once, which reduces the micromanagement required in combat. Grouping isn't always the best option, especially if you learn to overheat your guns using the Thermodynamics skill, but it's a good way to start.
blocks.zh: 此外，你还可以把相同的武器编组，这样就能一次性全部激活、装填或卸载弹药，减少战斗中的微操。编组并不总是最好的选择，特别是当你学会用热力学技能超载武器之后，但作为入门是个好办法。

blocks.en: Missiles are a little different because they aren't affected by tracking and have a simpler kind of range, but the same principle often applies to them. Note that "don't mix guns" doesn't mean you shouldn't put missile launchers in extra highslots if all your turret hardpoints are full and you want more DPS (as in, for example, a Stabber with four autocannons and two missile launchers). Remember, though, that there are other options worth considering for spare highslots, such as energy neutralisers/nosferatus, salvagers, tractor beams, remote repair modules and drone link augmentors.
blocks.zh: 导弹有点不同，因为它们不受跟踪速度影响，射程的概念也更简单，但同样的原则通常也适用。注意，“不要混用武器”并不意味着当你的炮台挂点全满、又想要更多 DPS 时，不应该在多余的高槽装导弹发射器（比如一艘装了四门自动加农炮和两个导弹发射器的刺客级）。不过要记住，多余的高槽还有其它值得考虑的选择，比如能量中和器 / 掠能器、打捞器、牵引光束、远程维修装备和无人机连接增强器。

blocks.en: There are exceptions to this principle, such as in dreadnought ratting, but they are extremely narrow and limited exceptions unlikely to apply to new players.
blocks.zh: 这一原则也有例外，比如用无畏舰刷怪，但这些例外极其有限，新玩家不太可能遇到。

blocks.en: Bigger guns aren't necessarily better
blocks.zh: 大炮未必更好

blocks.en: In EVE, small ships can sometimes outfly larger ships with, on paper, much higher potential damage outputs. A similar principle applies to some aspects of fitting, especially weapon fitting. Bigger guns do more DPS, assuming they hit, but they track targets more slowly and they use up more powergrid and CPU.
blocks.zh: 在 EVE 中，小船有时能胜过纸面潜在输出高得多的大船。类似的原则也适用于装配的某些方面，尤其是武器装配。假设能打中的话，更大的炮 DPS 更高，但它们跟踪目标更慢，消耗的能量栅格和 CPU 也更多。

blocks.en: So, for example, there are three kinds of medium-sized autocannon: Dual 180mm, 220mm, and 425mm. The 425mm autocannons do a bit more damage, but the 220mm autocannons have much more forgiving fitting requirements (especially if your fitting skills -- see below -- need more training). On some ships, it may be that fitting a rack of 425s would use up so much powergrid and CPU that you wouldn't be able to fit a tank. In that situation, fitting 220s would be better because, even though you would do a little less damage per second, your ship would survive longer and so would probably apply more total damage.
blocks.zh: 比如，中型自动加农炮有三种：双联 180mm、220mm 和 425mm。425mm 自动加农炮伤害高一点，但 220mm 自动加农炮的装配要求宽松得多（尤其是当你的装配技能——见下文——还需要多练的时候）。在某些舰船上，装一排 425 可能会占用太多能量栅格和 CPU，以至于没法装坦克。在这种情况下，装 220 会更好，因为虽然每秒伤害少一点，但你的船能活得更久，因此很可能打出更多总伤害。

blocks.en: This does not mean that you should fit frigate-sized guns on a cruiser. Downsizing within the available medium or large guns is sometimes wise, but downsizing from large to medium guns, or from mediums to smalls, usually isn't, unless you're fitting a bait ship or certain kinds of drone boat fits.
blocks.zh: 这并不是说你应该在巡洋舰上装护卫舰尺寸的炮。在可用的中型或大型炮之间降一档有时是明智的，但从大型炮降到中型炮、或从中型炮降到小型炮，通常就不明智了，除非你在装诱饵船或某些类型的无人机船配置。

blocks.en: Steal other people's ideas
blocks.zh: 借鉴别人的思路

blocks.en: EVE University has two ship loadout forums, where pilots can get comments on their fitting ideas. They have some threads with suggested fits. It's also worth searching the forums for past threads if you're interested in a particular ship. The #fitting-chat Discord channel should be the first place new players look for fits, and ask for advice. This forum is not publicly available.
blocks.zh: EVE University 有两个舰船配置论坛，飞行员可以在那里就自己的装配思路征求意见。论坛里有一些推荐配置的帖子。如果你对某艘船感兴趣，也值得在论坛里搜搜以前的帖子。新玩家找配置、寻求建议，首先应该去 Discord 的 #fitting-chat 频道。这个论坛不对外公开。

blocks.en: The wiki also has a page for each ship in EVE (e.g. Atron). These pages often have at least a few notes on basic approaches to fitting the ship.
blocks.zh: Wiki 上还为 EVE 中的每艘舰船都准备了一个页面（例如阿特龙级）。这些页面通常至少会有一些关于这艘船基本装配思路的说明。

blocks.en: You can also get advice in the University's chat channels or on the EVE Uni Discord. To link a fit that you have set up already into in-game chat, drag the ship's name from the fitting window and drop it into the chat entry box; to link one from the fittings browsing window, drag the image of the ship.)
blocks.zh: 你也可以在 EVE University 的聊天频道或 EVE Uni Discord 上寻求建议。要把你已经配好的配置链接到游戏内聊天中，从装配窗口拖动舰船名称放到聊天输入框里；要从配置浏览窗口链接，则拖动舰船的图片。）

blocks.en: The subreddit devoted to EVE ship fitting, r/fittings has active discussions of ship fittings and posts asking for suggested fits for specific play styles and ships. The material here varies in quality.
blocks.zh: 专门讨论 EVE 舰船装配的子版块 r/fittings 上有活跃的舰船配置讨论，也有针对特定玩法和舰船征求推荐配置的帖子。这里的内容质量参差不齐。

blocks.en: zkillboard.com shows you how people fit their ships in actual fights. Not everybody fits their ship smartly, of course, but if you can find players who are successfully doing what you want to do and identify their successful fits from their losses, you can often learn something. See this guide to make the most of zkillboard.
blocks.zh: zkillboard.com 能让你看到人们在实战中是如何装配舰船的。当然，不是每个人都配得很聪明，但如果你能找到那些成功做着你想做之事的玩家，并从他们的损失记录中分辨出成功的配置，往往能学到东西。请参阅这篇指南，充分利用 zkillboard。

blocks.en: Don't overuse fitting modules
blocks.zh: 不要过度使用装配类装备

blocks.en: There are some low-slot modules and rigs which increase your powergrid or CPU, and so are sometimes called "fitting modules". See below for how to decide on which fitting module to use.
blocks.zh: 有一些低槽装备和改装件可以增加能量栅格或 CPU，因此有时被称为“装配类装备”（fitting modules）。关于如何选择装配类装备，见下文。

blocks.en: It is sometimes necessary to use a fitting module or a fitting rig, but if you have a fit that requires more than one it's often a bad sign, and it may mean that you need better fitting skills, or are trying to fit too ambitiously. If you give up two or three slots for modules and rigs just to mount the rest of the fit on the ship, you will lose a lot of potential utility.
blocks.zh: 有时确实需要用一个装配类装备或装配类改装件，但如果一套配置需要不止一个，那往往是个坏兆头，可能意味着你需要更好的装配技能，或者你的配置野心太大了。如果为了把其余装备塞上船而放弃两三个槽位的装备和改装件，你会损失很多潜在的功能。

blocks.en: Like most of the other principles here, more experienced players can bend or break this for specialized reasons, but it's an excellent rule of thumb for new players.
blocks.zh: 和这里的大多数其它原则一样，有经验的玩家可能会出于特殊原因变通甚至打破这条规则，但对新玩家来说，这是一条极好的经验法则。

blocks.en: Ship simulation tools
blocks.zh: 舰船模拟工具

blocks.en: EVE includes a limited fit simulation tool, but you can also use more powerful third-party tools to try fits outside the game.
blocks.zh: EVE 自带一个功能有限的配置模拟工具，你也可以使用功能更强的第三方工具在游戏外试验配置。

blocks.en: The most popular tool in EVE University is PYFA. You can load your character's specific skill profile into Pyfa and see how a particular fitting would fly and fight with your character piloting it. Pyfa can even simulate the effects of different types of ammunition, overheating, drugs, command bursts, and incoming damage. Fits can be exported from Pyfa to the clipboard and then from the clipboard straight into your in-game fit library.
blocks.zh: EVE University 中最受欢迎的工具是 PYFA。你可以把自己角色的技能配置导入 Pyfa，查看某套配置在你的角色驾驶下的飞行和战斗表现。Pyfa 甚至可以模拟不同弹药、超载、药物、指挥脉冲和承受伤害的效果。配置可以从 Pyfa 导出到剪贴板，再从剪贴板直接导入游戏内的配置库。

blocks.en: Fit simulations are theory, of course, and don't always work out exactly as planned in practice: autocannon, for example, almost never deal their on-paper Pyfa DPS, because they are almost always operating in falloff range. For any especially high-stakes or experimental fits, consider gathering a few friends to help and trying them out on the test server, Singularity.
blocks.zh: 当然，配置模拟只是理论，实际使用时并不总能完全如预期：比如自动加农炮几乎永远打不出 Pyfa 里纸面上的 DPS，因为它们几乎总是在失准范围内作战。对于风险特别高或实验性的配置，可以考虑叫上几个朋友帮忙，到测试服 Singularity 上试一试。

blocks.en: Choosing modules (PvP)
blocks.zh: 选择装备（PvP）

blocks.en: Once you have selected the engagement range, role, and tank of your ship, comes the time to actually fit it. The following remarks are primarily PvP-oriented, though some are also useful considerations for PvE.
blocks.zh: 确定了舰船的交战距离、定位和坦克方式后，就该真正动手装配了。以下说明主要针对 PvP，不过有些对 PvE 也有参考价值。

blocks.en: Weapons
blocks.zh: 武器

blocks.en: For ships where damage is the primary purpose, start with weapons that are consistent with your engagement range and ship class: laser beams for snipers, artillery for skirmishers, blasters or rockets for brawlers etc. Try to use the most damaging weapons of the class that you've selected. You may have to downgrade them later (or may choose to downgrade them later so that everything will fit, or to improve tracking), but for now, if you're fitting blasters, try to fit neutron blasters, and so on.
blocks.zh: 对于以输出为主要目的的舰船，先选择与交战距离和舰船级别相符的武器：狙击用激光，游击用火炮，近战用疾速炮或火箭等等。尽量使用所选武器类别中伤害最高的型号。之后你可能不得不降级（或者为了把所有东西装上、或为了提高跟踪速度而选择降级），但目前来说，如果你装疾速炮，就先试着装中子疾速炮，以此类推。

blocks.en: Do not mix weapons and stick to weapons that go with your ship's bonuses. In addition, fit as many weapons as your ship has either missile or gun hard-points. As discussed above, do not mix different weapons, e.g. 220mm and 425mm autocannon.
blocks.zh: 不要混用武器，并选择与舰船加成相符的武器。此外，舰船有多少导弹或炮台挂点，就装多少武器。如上所述，不要混用不同的武器，比如 220mm 和 425mm 自动加农炮。

blocks.en: In a similar fashion, if the ship is designed to act as a logistics ship, the first thing to do is to fit the remote repair modules. If you are fitting an EWAR ship, start by fitting the EWAR modules that match your ship bonuses. If you are fitting a tackling ship, fit the propulsion and the tackle modules.
blocks.zh: 同样，如果这艘船设计用于后勤，首先要装的就是远程维修装备。如果你在装配电子战舰船，先装与舰船加成相符的电子战装备。如果你在装配拦截舰，就先装推进装备和拦截装备。

blocks.en: Role-enhancing modules
blocks.zh: 强化定位的装备

blocks.en: Now look at your ship's role. If your role is damage, you're probably already in good shape, but start to consider tracking and range. If you are going to be shield tanking, by default you should be using two damage-increasing modules consistent with your weapons in the lows. You might end up with one, you might end up with three. But start with two. If you have more than four low slots and will be using guns, you'll probably want to fit at least one Tracking Enhancer module as well. If you are going to be armor tanking, by default you should have one damage-increasing module consistent with your weapons in the lows.
blocks.zh: 接下来看看舰船的定位。如果你的定位是输出，大概已经差不多了，但要开始考虑跟踪速度和射程。如果你打算做护盾坦克，默认应该在低槽装两个与武器相符的伤害强化装备。最后可能是一个，也可能是三个，但先从两个开始。如果你有四个以上的低槽并且用的是炮台，可能还要至少装一个索敌增强器。如果你打算做装甲坦克，默认应该在低槽装一个与武器相符的伤害强化装备。

blocks.en: This also applies to ECM ships: if you are shield-tanking, try fitting two Signal Distortion Amplifiers. If you are armor-tanking, try to find room for one. This is generally a good rule of thumb for enhancing the damage or the other effects that your ship puts out.
blocks.zh: 这同样适用于 ECM 舰船：如果做护盾坦克，试着装两个信号畸变放大器；如果做装甲坦克，尽量腾出位置装一个。对于强化舰船的伤害或其它输出效果，这一般是很好的经验法则。

blocks.en: Finally, armor-tanking turret-using ships with lots of mid-slots should consider a Tracking Computer in one or perhaps two of them.
blocks.zh: 最后，使用炮台、做装甲坦克且中槽较多的舰船，应该考虑在一到两个中槽装索敌计算机。

blocks.en: Nearly all PvP ships should give a single mid slot over to a propulsion module, something to increase your ship's speed. You must choose between a Microwarpdrive (MWD) or Afterburner (AB). An MWD allows greater maneuverability which makes them more commonly fit. However, MWDs bloom your ship's signature radius (making you an easier target) and are disabled by warp scramblers. ABs are popular on brawling armor ships, as they enable a signature tank against larger opponents and cannot be shut off by the warp scramblers used at close ranges.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有 PvP 舰船都应该拿出一个中槽装推进装备，用来提高舰船速度。你必须在微型跃迁推进器（MWD）和加力燃烧器（AB）之间选择。MWD 机动性更强，所以更常见。不过，MWD 会让舰船的信号半径暴涨（让你更容易被打中），而且会被跃迁扰乱设备关掉。AB 在近战装甲舰船上很受欢迎，因为它能在面对体型更大的对手时实现信号半径坦克，而且不会被近距离使用的跃迁扰乱设备关掉。

blocks.en: Most PvP ships should give a single mid slot to a tackle module of some type. For skirmishers (specialized scouts), primary damage, and screening ships this should nearly always be a "long point", a Warp Disruptor of some kind. Ships in a tackle role should usually fit a Warp Scrambler module of some kind. Some types of scout and initial tackle might want to try fitting both a point and a scram. Ships in other roles in larger fleets can forgo tackle modules. In a small gang it is often desirable to have a tackle module on almost every ship. Space permitting, a web is desirable on close-range damage dealers. Stasis Webifiers do not hold the target on grid as points and scrams do, but they slow the target down, hampering kiters and helping your tracking and missile hits.
blocks.zh: 大多数 PvP 舰船应该拿出一个中槽装某种拦截装备。对于游击舰（专门的侦察舰）、主力输出舰和掩护舰，这几乎总应该是“长点”，即某种跃迁扰断器。担任拦截的舰船通常应该装某种跃迁扰乱设备。某些侦察舰和先手拦截舰可能会想同时装长点和短点（扰乱）。大舰队中担任其它定位的舰船可以不装拦截装备。在小队中，通常希望几乎每艘船都带一个拦截装备。如果有空间，近距离输出舰最好装一个网子。停滞缠绕光束不能像长点和短点那样把目标留在网格上，但能让目标减速，克制风筝打法，并有助于你的炮台跟踪和导弹命中。

blocks.en: ECM is a big danger to logistics, so logistics pilots should consider fitting ECCM to counter it. A sensor booster (either to counter sensor dampening or to allow your to apply reps faster) should also be considered.
blocks.zh: ECM 对后勤是很大的威胁，所以后勤飞行员应该考虑装 ECCM 来对抗它。也应该考虑装一个感应增强器（用于对抗感应抑阻，或让你更快地给出维修）。

blocks.en: Tank
blocks.zh: 坦克

blocks.en: Next, consider your tank. First, fit a Damage Control unit of some kind. T2 Damage Controls should always be favored, but meta 3 or 4 can sometimes be chosen due to dramatically less CPU usage (bear in mind that meta 4 damage controls are quite costly). If fitting an Assault Frigate or Heavy Assault Cruiser, use an Assault Damage Control instead.
blocks.zh: 接下来考虑坦克。首先，装一个损伤控制。应该优先选择 T2 损伤控制，但有时也可以选择元等级 3 或 4 的型号，因为它们的 CPU 占用低得多（要注意元等级 4 的损伤控制相当贵）。如果装配的是突击护卫舰或重型突击巡洋舰，则改用突击型损伤控制。

blocks.en: Buffer armor tanks use between two (generally for T1 frigates) and six (generally for battleships or logistics) low slots. In order, fit the following:
blocks.zh: 缓冲装甲坦克要用两个（一般是 T1 护卫舰）到六个（一般是战列舰或后勤舰）低槽。按顺序装配以下装备：

en: the heaviest armor plate your ship can fit consistent with its size and your guns (i.e. 200 or 400mm for frigates and destroyers, 800 or 1600mm for cruisers, 1600mm for battlecruisers and battleships). You should fit T2 if you can, downgrading to meta 4 otherwise.
A Multispectrum Energized Membrane (MEM, formerly known as an EANM), T2 if you can
A second T2 MEM, or a Multispectrum Coating (formerly known as an ANP) if it won't fit
NB: A T2 Coating is both easier to fit and gives better bonuses than a meta MEM
look at your four armor resistances and "close" the one that is lowest with a single active armor hardener of the appropriate type
if you are flying a battleship, consider adding a second plate.
either add a 3rd MEM, or a reactive armor hardener; alternatively, consider removing both MEMs and fitting 3 active hardeners of your lowest resists
zh: 与舰船体型和武器相符、舰船能装上的最重的装甲附甲板（即护卫舰和驱逐舰用 200 或 400mm，巡洋舰用 800 或 1600mm，战列巡洋舰和战列舰用 1600mm）。能装 T2 就装 T2，否则降级到元等级 4。
一个多谱式电压薄膜（MEM，以前叫 EANM），能装 T2 就装 T2
第二个 T2 MEM，如果装不下，就装一个多谱式涂层（以前叫 ANP）
注意：T2 涂层比元等级的 MEM 更容易装配，加成也更好
看看四种装甲抗性，用一个对应类型的主动装甲增强器“补上”最低的那项
如果你开的是战列舰，考虑再加一块附甲板。
要么加第三个 MEM，要么加一个反应式装甲增强器；或者，考虑去掉两个 MEM，换成三个针对你最低抗性的主动增强器

blocks.en: Remember that on DD ships you want to leave room for at least one damage module (e.g. magnetic field stabilizer for hybrids), and often two.
blocks.zh: 记住，在输出舰上要至少留出一个伤害装备的位置（比如混合炮用的磁场稳定设备），通常是两个。

blocks.en: Buffer shield tanks operate in a very similar fashion but with one fewer slot, using between two and five. In order, fit the following:
blocks.zh: 缓冲护盾坦克的做法非常相似，但少用一个槽位，用两到五个。按顺序装配以下装备：

en: a Large Shield Extender (for cruisers and larger) or a Medium Shield Extender (for frigates and destroyers).
one Multispectrum Shield Hardener, or if cap is an issue (and you are only using two slots) possibly a second shield extender of the same type
look at your four shield resistances and "close" the one that is lowest with a single active shield hardener of the appropriate type
a second Multispectrum Shield Hardener
if you have the power grid for it, a second Large Shield Extender
zh: 一个大型护盾扩展装置（巡洋舰及以上）或中型护盾扩展装置（护卫舰和驱逐舰）。
一个多谱式护盾增强器；如果电容紧张（且你只用两个槽位），也可以再装一个同型号的护盾扩展装置
看看四种护盾抗性，用一个对应类型的主动护盾强化设备“补上”最低的那项
第二个多谱式护盾增强器
如果能量栅格够用，再装第二个大型护盾扩展装置

blocks.en: Active armor tanks operate in a similar fashion but generally replace the plates with Armor Repair Modules plus one Ancillary Armor Repair module of the appropriate size. They may also replace MEMs with a second (and sometimes even third!) armor repairer. Active shield tanks replace the Shield Extenders with one or perhaps two Shield Boosters, the first of which is usually an X-Large Ancillary Shield Booster (cruisers and up) or Medium Ancillary Shield Booster (frigates). Use caution if intending to fit a Large Ancillary Shield Booster. In most applications, it will not repair sufficient damage to be useful.
blocks.zh: 主动装甲坦克的做法类似，但一般把附甲板换成装甲维修器，外加一个相应尺寸的辅助装甲维修器。也可能把 MEM 换成第二个（有时甚至第三个！）装甲维修器。主动护盾坦克则把护盾扩展装置换成一到两个护盾回充增量器，其中第一个通常是超大型辅助护盾回充增量器（巡洋舰及以上）或中型辅助护盾回充增量器（护卫舰）。如果打算装大型辅助护盾回充增量器要谨慎。在大多数情况下，它修复的伤害不足以发挥作用。

blocks.en: Passive shield tanking is not normally used for PvP because the incoming damage in PvP is usually higher than a passive shield recharge rate can keep up with, even when enhanced by modules and ship bonuses.
blocks.zh: 被动护盾坦克通常不用于 PvP，因为 PvP 中受到的伤害通常高于被动护盾回充速度所能承受的程度，即使有装备和舰船加成强化也一样。

blocks.en: Fitting modules
blocks.zh: 装配类装备

blocks.en: At this point, you are possibly running out of power grid, CPU, or both. It is at this point that you begin to have to consider using "fitting mods." Fitting mods operate by closing the gaps in your fit to allow everything you want to use to fit on the ship. In general, you should try not to use fitting mods unless the fit absolutely demands it. The six most common fitting mods are:
blocks.zh: 到这一步，你可能已经快用完能量栅格或 CPU，或者两者都不够了。这时就要开始考虑使用“装配类装备”了。装配类装备的作用是填补配置中的缺口，让你想用的所有东西都能装上船。一般来说，除非配置确实非用不可，否则尽量不要使用装配类装备。最常见的六种装配类装备是：

en: Ancillary Current Router rig
Power Diagnostic System low slot module
Reactor Control Unit low slot module
Micro Auxiliary Power Core (MAPC) low slot module.
Co-Processor low slot module
Processor Overclocking Unit rig
zh: 辅助电源路由器改装件
能源诊断系统（低槽装备）
反应堆控制元件（低槽装备）
微型辅助能源核心（MAPC，低槽装备）。
协处理器（低槽装备）
处理器超频组件改装件

blocks.en: The first four increase your power grid; the MAPC is for greatly increasing grid on frigates--it is common on shield tanked frigates--and the RCU is for greatly increasing grid on ships bigger than frigates. The last two increase your CPU.
blocks.zh: 前四种增加能量栅格；MAPC 用于大幅增加护卫舰的能量栅格——在护盾坦克护卫舰上很常见——而 RCU 用于大幅增加护卫舰以上舰船的能量栅格。后两种增加 CPU。

blocks.en: In general, try to use the rig first before sacrificing a valuable low-slot module. Under almost no circumstances is fitting more than two fitting mods a good choice. If you find yourself fitting more than two fitting mods, you have probably made an incorrect choice in your ship fit somewhere. Fit meta 4 shield extenders or plates; reduce the number of shield extenders or plates; or reduce the guns you have chosen by one grade, from (for instance) neutron blasters to ion blasters, or from 425mm autocannons to 220mm autocannons.
blocks.zh: 一般来说，在牺牲宝贵的低槽之前，先尝试用改装件。几乎在任何情况下，装两个以上的装配类装备都不是好选择。如果你发现自己装了两个以上的装配类装备，很可能是配置中某处选择有误。可以改装元等级 4 的护盾扩展装置或附甲板；减少护盾扩展装置或附甲板的数量；或者把所选的炮降一档，比如从中子疾速炮降到离子疾速炮，或者从 425mm 自动加农炮降到 220mm 自动加农炮。

blocks.en: As you adjust the fit of your ship, do not be afraid to change some of the modules from T2 to meta modules, usually meta 4 modules. This most often applies to Shield Extenders, your Damage Control, your point or scram, and your afterburner if not already meta (microwarpdives should never be T2). These changes will give you back a couple of percent of power grid or CPU here and there and are often all that's needed to bring a fit into line if the fit is close. It is usually not a good idea to change your resistance modules for meta modules; they are far less effective than T2 modules.
blocks.zh: 在调整舰船配置时，不要害怕把一些装备从 T2 换成元等级装备，通常是元等级 4。最常见的是护盾扩展装置、损伤控制、长点或短点，以及（如果还不是元等级的话）加力燃烧器（微型跃迁推进器永远不应该用 T2）。这些改动能东一点西一点地省出百分之几的能量栅格或 CPU，如果配置只差一点，往往就足够了。抗性装备一般不建议换成元等级装备，它们的效果远不如 T2 装备。

blocks.en: Speed tanking
blocks.zh: 速度坦克

blocks.en: Speed-tanking operates in a similar fashion but reduces the maximum number of tanking modules available to one or two, usually focusing on shield. Most often, a Medium Shield Extender (often of the meta variety) and a Damage Control module are the two modules chosen. Alternately, other ships work well with two Large Shield Extenders and a Damage Control. In general, if you have only a few tanking modules on a ship, it is better to increase buffer with those that you do use unless you are also flying with a logistics ship, in which case you can replace one with a single module to increase your resists.
blocks.zh: 速度坦克的做法类似，但把坦克装备的最大数量减少到一到两个，通常以护盾为主。最常见的选择是一个中型护盾扩展装置（常用元等级型号）加一个损伤控制。另外，也有些舰船适合用两个大型护盾扩展装置加一个损伤控制。一般来说，如果舰船上只有寥寥几个坦克装备，最好用它们来增加缓冲量；除非你还有后勤舰同行，那样可以把其中一个换成提高抗性的装备。

blocks.en: Final slots
blocks.zh: 最后的槽位

blocks.en: At this point, you may have a low slot or two free. You may have a mid slot or two free. And you may have a high slot or two free.
blocks.zh: 到这一步，你可能还剩一两个低槽、一两个中槽，以及一两个高槽。

blocks.en: High slots are the easiest, and the only ones you should consider leaving empty (due to high fitting requirements of the options). For ships in a tackle role, a NOS is usually the best choice. For ships in all other roles, a neut is usually the best choice. Remember to intersperse your utility highslot modules or your empty highslots between your weapons, to absorb heat damage when overheating.
blocks.zh: 高槽最好办，也是唯一可以考虑空着的槽位（因为可选装备的装配要求都很高）。对于担任拦截的舰船，掠能器通常是最佳选择。对于其它所有定位的舰船，能量中和器通常是最佳选择。记得把功能性高槽装备或空高槽穿插在武器之间，以便在超载时吸收热损伤。

blocks.en: A free low slot should be given to an additional damage module, an additional Tracking Enhancer, or (if you're running short of CPU), a Nanofiber Internal Structure. An additional mid slot should be given to an additional tackle mod (usually a Stasis Webifier), a Capacitor Booster, or some form of utility electronic warfare, usually a Sensor Dampener.
blocks.zh: 多出的低槽应该装一个额外的伤害装备、额外的索敌增强器，或者（如果 CPU 不够）纳米纤维内部构架。多出的中槽应该装一个额外的拦截装备（通常是停滞缠绕光束）、电容注电器，或者某种辅助性的电子战装备，通常是感应抑阻器。

blocks.en: Inertia Stabilizers should not be fit on PvP ships under any circumstances. Sensor Boosters can be fit on PvP ships but should be fit only with a great deal of care and consideration; the most common use-case is for gate camping. In a gang, this module will nearly always draw derision unless it is specifically required for sniping applications or the like.
blocks.zh: 在任何情况下，PvP 舰船都不应该装惯性稳定器。感应增强器可以装在 PvP 舰船上，但要非常谨慎、深思熟虑后再装；最常见的用途是堵门。在小队中，除非狙击等用途确实需要，否则装这个装备几乎总会招来嘲笑。

blocks.en: Finally, modules that passively regenerate some aspect of your ship's operation should almost never be used in PvP. These include Cap Rechargers, Cap Power Relays, Shield Rechargers, and Shield Power Relays. While these modules are fine for PvE, the incoming damage or capacitor costs in PvP will generally be too strong for these modules to have much if any effect.
blocks.zh: 最后，被动回复舰船某方面性能的装备在 PvP 中几乎永远不应该使用。包括电容器回充设备、电容能源继电器、护盾回充设备和护盾能源继电器。这些装备在 PvE 中没问题，但在 PvP 中，受到的伤害或电容消耗通常太大，这些装备几乎起不了什么作用。

blocks.en: Rigs
blocks.zh: 改装件

blocks.en: Finally and last, rig your ship using any remaining rig slots. In general, at the basic level, buffer shield tanking ships should use a full set of Core Defense Field Extender rigs. Passive armor ships should use a full set of Trimark Armor Pumps. This will increase the size of your ship's buffer and extend your life on the battlefield. Active tanking ships use more specialized rigs. Active armor-tanking ships can use two Auxiliary Nano Pump rigs and one Nanobot Accelerator rig. Active shield-tanking ships can give one or two rig slots over to increasing shield resistances but may also use a Core Defense Operational Solidifier or (much more rarely) a Core Defense Capacitor Safeguard. Of course, if you have given over some rig slots to fitting rigs, you will have fewer rigs to devote to defense.
blocks.zh: 最后，用剩下的改装件槽位给舰船装改装件。一般来说，在基础阶段，缓冲护盾坦克舰船应该装满核心防御力场扩张装置改装件，被动装甲舰船应该装满三角装甲聚合器。这会增加舰船的缓冲量，延长你在战场上的存活时间。主动坦克舰船则使用更专门的改装件。主动装甲坦克舰船可以用两个辅助纳米聚合器改装件加一个纳米机器人加速器改装件。主动护盾坦克舰船可以拿出一两个改装件槽位提高护盾抗性，也可以用核心防御操控稳定装置，或者（少见得多）核心防御电容器安全管理装置。当然，如果你已经把一些改装件槽位用在了装配类改装件上，可用于防御的改装件就更少了。

blocks.en: As with passive regeneration modules, do not use the Core Defense Field Purger rig in PvP at the basic level. While there are advanced level ships that can (and do) use this rig successfully in PvP, newer players should stick with increasing buffer.
blocks.zh: 和被动回复类装备一样，在基础阶段不要在 PvP 中使用核心防御力场稳固装置改装件。虽然有些进阶舰船能够（而且确实）在 PvP 中成功使用这种改装件，但新玩家还是应该专注于增加缓冲量。

blocks.en: Fitting math
blocks.zh: 装配数学

blocks.en: In EVE, there are two types of modifiers.
blocks.zh: EVE 中有两种修正值。

en: Flat modifiers are added directly to whatever stat they affect. For example, 1600mm Steel Plates I increases armor by 3500.
Percent modifiers multiply the stat they affect. For example, Hull Upgrades IV gives a 20% bonus to armor (or, more precisely, multiplies armor by 1.2).
zh: 固定值修正直接加到所影响的属性上。比如，1600mm钢附甲板 I 增加 3500 装甲。
百分比修正会乘以所影响的属性。比如，船体加固理论 IV提供 20% 装甲加成（更准确地说，是把装甲乘以 1.2）。

blocks.en: Basic bonuses
blocks.zh: 基础加成

blocks.en: Two 25% bonus give a 56% bonus. Two 50% bonuses give a 125% bonus. More bonuses are generally better than one big bonus. Best is lots of big bonuses.
blocks.zh: 两个 25% 的加成合计 56%。两个 50% 的加成合计 125%。多个加成通常比一个大加成更好。最好的是很多个大加成。

blocks.en: When percent modifiers combine, they multiply by each other. For example, Hull Upgrades IV gives +20% armor and a Layered Plating II module gives +8% armor. This doesn't give +28% armor, but instead:
blocks.zh: 百分比修正叠加时是相乘的。比如，船体加固理论 IV提供 +20% 装甲，一个覆层附甲 II（Layered Plating II）提供 +8% 装甲。合计并不是 +28% 装甲，而是：

blocks.en: As noted above, percentages are really just multipliers. For example, +20% is a 1.2 multiplier, and +8% is a 1.08 multiplier. This changes the above formula into:
blocks.zh: 如上所述，百分比其实就是乘数。比如，+20% 就是 1.2 倍，+8% 就是 1.08 倍。这样上面的公式就变成：

blocks.en: As an example, lets take a look at the Harbinger with a 1600mm Steel Plates I, Hull Upgrades IV and a Layered Plating II. The base armor for the Harbinger is 5250. The plate gives 3500 more armor and, as we saw above, Hull Upgrades IV gives a 1.2 multiplier and layered plating a 1.08 multiplier.
blocks.zh: 举个例子，来看一艘装了 1600mm钢附甲板 I、拥有船体加固理论 IV并装了一个覆层附甲 II 的先驱者级。先驱者级的基础装甲是 5250。附甲板增加 3500 装甲，而如上所述，船体加固理论 IV提供 1.2 倍乘数，覆层附甲提供 1.08 倍乘数。

blocks.en: So the Harbinger will end up with 11,340 HP of armor.
blocks.zh: 所以这艘先驱者级最终会有 11,340 HP 装甲。

blocks.en: Basic reductions
blocks.zh: 基础削减

blocks.en: Some reductions are actually bonuses. Two 25% reductions make a 44% reduction. Two 50% reductions make a 75% reduction. One big reduction is better than lots of small ones.
blocks.zh: 有些削减其实是加成。两个 25% 的削减合计 44%。两个 50% 的削减合计 75%。一个大削减比很多个小削减更好。

blocks.en: Again, like bonuses, reductions are best thought of as multipliers. For example, a 25% reduction is a 0.75 multiplier.
blocks.zh: 同样，和加成一样，削减最好理解为乘数。比如，25% 的削减就是 0.75 倍。

blocks.en: Stacking penalties
blocks.zh: 叠加惩罚

blocks.en: Main article: Stacking penalties
blocks.zh: 主条目：叠加惩罚

blocks.en: Stacking Penalties, also known as diminishing returns, keeps players from applying many bonuses to the same stat. Stacking penalties apply only to modules and rigs. Skills and Ship Bonuses/Penalties always have full effect.
blocks.zh: 叠加惩罚（Stacking Penalties），也叫收益递减，用于防止玩家对同一属性叠加过多加成。叠加惩罚只适用于装备和改装件。技能和舰船加成 / 减益始终完全生效。

blocks.en: The biggest modifier from a module always gives its full effect to a stat; the next-biggest modifier has a somewhat reduced effect; the third-biggest modifier has a greatly reduced effect, and so on:
blocks.zh: 装备提供的最大修正值始终对属性完全生效；第二大的修正值效果略有降低；第三大的修正值效果大幅降低，依此类推：

en: 1st = Fully effective (100%)
2nd ≈ 87% effectiveness
3rd ≈ 57% effectiveness
4th ≈ 28% effectiveness
5th ≈ 10% effectiveness
6th ≈ 3% effectiveness
zh: 第 1 个 = 完全生效（100%）
第 2 个 ≈ 87% 效果
第 3 个 ≈ 57% 效果
第 4 个 ≈ 28% 效果
第 5 个 ≈ 10% 效果
第 6 个 ≈ 3% 效果

blocks.en: These are described by the following function, where n is 1 for the first module, 2 for the second module, etc.:
blocks.zh: 它们可以用以下函数描述，其中第一个装备的 n 为 1，第二个为 2，依此类推：

blocks.en: Effectiveness=0.5(0.45×(n−1))2

This effect means that it usually doesn't make sense to fit more than three modules that improve any one attribute. For example, a Ballistic Control System I increases missile damage by 7%. The first module fit to a ship gives the full bonus, but the second will only give an additional 7% × 87% = 6.1% bonus, the third 7% × 57% = 4.0%, and the fourth 7% × 28% = 2.0%.
blocks.zh: 这意味着装三个以上提升同一属性的装备通常没有意义。比如，弹道控制系统 I 提高 7% 导弹伤害。装在舰船上的第一个提供完整加成，但第二个只额外提供 7% × 87% = 6.1% 的加成，第三个 7% × 57% = 4.0%，第四个 7% × 28% = 2.0%。

blocks.en: As the biggest modifiers take the smallest stacking penalties, this means that even if a large number of people have a Remote Sensor Booster I on a target, if someone turns on a Remote Sensor Booster II, they will see at least the 5% difference between the Sensor Booster I and II, plus any gains seen by the addition of a single sensor booster at the highest diminishing returns.
blocks.zh: 由于最大的修正值受到的叠加惩罚最小，这意味着即使已经有很多人对某个目标开了远程感应增强器 I，如果有人开启远程感应增强器 II，目标也至少会获得感应增强器 I 和 II 之间 5% 的差值，再加上以最大递减程度多叠加一个感应增强器所带来的提升。

blocks.en: Almost all modules that boost or penalize a stat affected by stacking penalties will say so in their description: "Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same..."
blocks.zh: 几乎所有会提升或降低受叠加惩罚影响属性的装备，都会在说明中注明：“惩罚：使用一个以上此类装备，或影响同一……的类似装备”

blocks.en: Stacking penalties also affect some remote modules such as the Remote Sensor Booster, Sensor Dampener, Tracking Disruptor and the like. These can come from many different sources and can interact with modules fitted on the ship. Stacking penalties are cumulative for all sources, local or remote.
blocks.zh: 叠加惩罚也会影响一些远程装备，如远程感应增强器、感应抑阻器、索敌扰断器等。这些效果可能来自许多不同的来源，并且会与舰船上装配的装备相互作用。叠加惩罚对所有来源（本地或远程）都是累计计算的。

blocks.en: Resistances
blocks.zh: 抗性

blocks.en: Resistances are best thought of as reductions to incoming damage. Each mod affects one or all of the four resistances for each layer of defence. It's easy to see that the −25% EM Damage Resistance Bonus of the Multispectrum Shield Hardener I on a ship with 0% EM resistance would reduce incoming damage by 25%. If the ship has 20% thermal resistance already, then you need to multiply the penalties to incoming damage together:
blocks.zh: 抗性最好理解为对受到伤害的削减。每个装备会影响每层防御四种抗性中的一种或全部。很容易看出，在电磁抗性为 0% 的舰船上，多谱式护盾增强器 I 的 −25% 电磁伤害抗性加成会把受到的伤害降低 25%。如果舰船已经有 20% 的热能抗性，就需要把对受到伤害的削减相乘：

blocks.en: 20% base resistance (1−0.2)=0.8
25% Multispectrum Shield Hardener (1−0.25)=0.75
(1−0.6)=0.4 or 40% resistance.

Besides the base resistances of the ship and the Damage Control module, all resistance rigs/modules suffer a stacking penalty. The stacking penalty is ordered highest to lowest per resistance, not per rig/module, which means the highest resistance module for that resistance is calculated first, even though that may not be the highest resist module for another resist.
blocks.zh: 除了舰船的基础抗性和损伤控制装备之外，所有抗性改装件 / 装备都会受到叠加惩罚。叠加惩罚是按每种抗性从高到低排序的，而不是按改装件 / 装备排序。这意味着对某种抗性来说加成最高的装备会最先计算，即使它对另一种抗性来说可能并不是加成最高的。

blocks.en: For example, a ship with base shield resistances, an Multispectrum Shield Hardener I, an Anti-EM Shield Hardener I, a Thermal Shield Hardener I, and a Damage Control I would have the following.
blocks.zh: 比如，一艘具有基础护盾抗性的舰船，装了一个多谱式护盾增强器 I、一个电磁护盾增强器 I、一个热能护盾增强器 I 和一个损伤控制 I，抗性如下。

blocks.en: EM: (base)1.0×(DCU)0.925×(EMShieldHardener)0.5×(MultispectrumShieldHardener(diminished))(1−0.25×0.8691)=0.361, or 64%
Thermal: (base)0.8×(DCU)0.925×(ThermalShieldHardenerI)0.5×(MultispectrumShieldHardener(diminished))(1−0.25×0.8691)=0.289, or 71%
Explosive: 65%
Three Multispectrum Shield Hardeners, due to diminishing returns would provide much lower EM and Thermal (38% and 50%) with only a 63% kinetic resistance.
blocks.zh: 由于收益递减，三个多谱式护盾增强器提供的电磁和热能抗性要低得多（38% 和 50%），动能抗性也只有 63%。

blocks.en: Alternatively, a slightly less complex calculation is that a resistance module improves resistance but only on the remaining part. Using our Multispectrum Shield Hardener I example above, the ship has a 20% base thermal resist profile already. So, the Adaptive Invulnerability I module applies its 25% but only to the 80% remaining hole (i.e. it provides 25% of 80% => 20% effectiveness) and our thermal resistance is now 40%.
blocks.zh: 另一种稍微简单些的算法是：抗性装备提升抗性，但只作用于剩余的部分。用上面多谱式护盾增强器 I 的例子，舰船本来已经有 20% 的基础热能抗性。所以自适应无懈可击 I（Adaptive Invulnerability I）装备的 25% 只作用于剩下 80% 的缺口（即提供 80% 的 25% => 20% 的效果），于是热能抗性变为 40%。

blocks.zh: 延伸阅读

zh: 舰船装配实例：舰船装配（实例）
